{{Top|leg}}
The '''miniature concussion missile system'''<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> or '''miniature concussion missile launcher'''<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> was an integrated weapon used by [[Battle droid/Legends|military droids]]. The [[ZQ Infantry Support Unit]] was equipped with a miniature concussion missile system that had an ammunition magazine of ten [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]].<ref name="CFTD" /> [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms']] [[SD-10 battle droid]] was equipped with a miniature concussion missile launcher along with an improved [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] package.<ref name="EGTD" />
